description: Create a video, creator, UGC or editor brief with hooks and shot direction from a completed Study revision: pass studyContext ({studyRef, revision, findingId: "action"}), as socialseal_get_study returns it. Without studyContext, or with one that cannot support a brief, nothing runs or is charged: the result is status study_needed with ranked candidates (each with exact socialseal_start_study arguments) and reuse (a recent Study's studyContext, if one fits). Agree a subject with the user, start it, then retry. Carry approved audience/product facts and constraints in brandContext; do not assume project documents are loaded. Read existing work with socialseal_get_brief, edit with socialseal_update_brief, and export with socialseal_export_brief before formatting as Word/PDF. May consume credits under existing controls. Generated status does not establish factual accuracy, executable timing or creative quality; inspect the returned evidence and missing-data states. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation, pricing, balance and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.

notes.description: Concise approved audience needs, product/service facts with source references, voice/CTA, exclusions and production constraints. Distinguish verified facts from unknowns. This field does not automatically retrieve project files or verify claims.

competitor.description: Competitor name or handle the brief is about; ranks the proposed Study subjects.

creator.description: Creator handle the brief is about; ranks the proposed Study subjects.

idempotencyKey.description: Generate once per intended request and reuse it for retries, after a quote and after an upgrade. A new key starts new billable work.

topic.description: Topic the brief is about; ranks the Study subjects proposed when no Study is given.
